source.author: cic
source.text: Hic, ut saepe inter homines sapientissimos constare vidi, quamquam hoc Crasso, cum aliquid accuratius dixisset, semper fere contigisset, ut numquam dixisse melius putaretur, tamen omnium consensu sic esse tum iudicatum ceteros a Crasso semper omnis, illo autem die etiam ipsum a se superatum.
source.text_original: Hic, ut saepe inter homines sapientissimos constare vidi, quamquam hoc Crasso, cum aliquid accuratius dixisset, semper fere contigisset, ut numquam dixisse melius putaretur, tamen omnium consensu sic esse tum iudicatum ceteros a Crasso semper omnis, illo autem die etiam ipsum a se superatum.
source.text_english: Here, as I have often seen it agreed among the wisest men, although this had almost always happened to Crassus, whenever he had said something more carefully, so that he was never thought to have spoken better, nevertheless by everyone’s agreement it was then judged that all others had always been surpassed by Crassus, but on that day that he himself too had been surpassed by himself.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: et praecipue mihi in eo subdiuisio placuit; cumque in primis partibus uincas alios, in paenultimis te ipsum superas.
reuse.text_original: et praecipue mihi in eo subdiuisio placuit; cumque in primis partibus uincas alios, in paenultimis te ipsum superas.
reuse.text_english: And especially I was pleased with the subdivision in it; and although in the first parts you surpass others, in the next-to-last you surpass yourself.
